meta.title: Sponsorship Recruitment | Nomad in Thailand
meta.desc: We are looking for individuals and corporate sponsors to support Nomad in Thailand's activities.

hero.title:
"Nomad in Thailand"
Partner & Sponsor Recruitment
hero.subtitle: To all those seeking a free way of life.{br}We are recruiting partners to support and enliven our activities.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.p1: "I want to leave Japan and work abroad."{br}Many people dream of this, but few actually take action. Visa hurdles, language barriers, and the fear of "Can I really make it?"
intro.p2: "We want to encourage more young people to take on challenges overseas"
intro.p3: "Nomad in Thailand" was born from this vision. I've carved out my path as a Bangkok-based nomad through many failures. By sharing all my experiences, I want to push others to follow.
intro.p4: Today, like-minded people have gathered, and we've grown into a community that shares real information and experiences.
intro.p5: We're looking for partners who want to grow this movement with us.

profile.title: About the Organizer
profile.desc1: A digital nomad based in Thailand with a DTV visa.{br}With the motto "Give more young people the option to go overseas," continuing to share experiences through content.
profile.desc2: Not just success stories, but also failures and real struggles. Creating content that makes viewers feel "Maybe I can do this too" rather than thinking it's "someone else's story."

roadmap.title: Future Roadmap (2026)
roadmap.desc: Your support will be carefully used for equipment costs, editing costs, and event expenses.

step1.title: Jan - Mar: Foundation & Community Launch
items: ・ Strengthen collaboration with "Nomad in Thailand" site

step2.title: Apr - Jun: Sharing Experiences & Creating Excitement

step4.title: Oct - Dec: Culmination of 2026
items: ・ "Overseas Retreat" to tune mind and body

stability.title: To Continue Activities Stably for the Long Term
stability.p1: Until now, we have operated on personal funds, but to improve content quality and continue responsible operation, a solid operational structure is essential.
stability.p2: Your support will be used carefully for production costs to create better content, coverage costs for deep local information, and operating costs for member interaction.
stability.p3: We want to build a "reliable place" together that will last 10 years, not just a passing trend.

partner.title: Future Drawn with Partners
partner.p1: We want to build a partnership where we can walk in the same direction, not just place ads.
partner.p2: We will confidently introduce services and products that are truly useful to listeners aiming for "new ways of working" and "challenges to the world".

cm.title: CM & Service Intro in Program
cm.desc: We will naturally introduce your service as "one of the topics" at the beginning/middle of YouTube videos (talk/chat format) or within Podcast audio. Possible to promote directly to the 20s-30s demographic who "want to challenge overseas" or "want to change how they work".

collab.title: Collab Video & Coverage
collab.desc: We will visit your office or store for coverage, or produce and publish interview videos with representatives.

link.title: Posting in Description
link.desc: We will permanently post your link and name as a sponsor in the description of all episodes.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Q. Which is main, YouTube or Podcast?
faq.a1: We are currently focusing on YouTube video distribution, but we are also distributing audio-only Podcasts (Spotify only) in parallel. We can introduce you on both media.
faq.q2: Q. Is there posting on "Nomad in Thailand" site?
faq.a2: Yes, depending on the plan, we can propose banner posting on this site "Nomad in Thailand" and creation of collaborative articles as a set.

conclusion.title: Finally
conclusion.p1: Thank you for reading to the end.{br}If you sympathize even a little with our activities and vision, please contact us once.
conclusion.p2: It''s okay if you don''t have a concrete plan yet.{br}We would be happy if you could contact us casually for consultation on whether we can work together.
conclusion.p3: Small donations (activity support) from individuals are also very encouraging.

cta.title: Partnership Consultation
cta.desc: Please contact us first for consultation on collaboration or sponsorship.
